study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
exposure: Labor prior to Cesarean delivery (intrapartum CD)
cohort: 720 women undergoing CD at six academic medical centers in the United States
finding: Women who experienced labor prior to CD had higher pain scores on the day of surgery and increased opioid requirements following discharge.
mod_finding: Intrapartum cesarean delivery was associated with worse pain on the day of surgery and increased opioid requirements following discharge.
